result.rationale: The diff adds `totalPages: Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1` in admin-group.js.es6. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g., 100 members, limit 50), this yields 3 pages when only 2 exist. Since `showingLast` is `propertyEqual("currentPage", "totalPages")` and currentPage is `floor(offset/limit)+1`, on the actual last page currentPage=2 ≠ totalPages=3, so showingLast is false and the 'next' action remains enabled. Math.ceil(user_count/limit) is the correct computation. The mechanism is fully verifiable from the diff.

judged_text: admin-group.js.es6: totalPages = Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 is off-by-one when user_count % limit == 0 (100 members, limit 50 yields totalPages 3 when only 2 pages exist), so showingLast fails on the real last page and 'next' stays enabled; correct math is Math.ceil(user_count/limit) (or floor((user_count-1)/limit)+1).

adjudication.rationale: In admin-group.js.es6, totalPages is computed as Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 when user_count > 0. This overcounts when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g., 100/50 => 3 instead of 2). Because showingLast is based on currentPage == totalPages, the UI will not consider page 2 the last page, leaving "next" enabled. The next action can then advance offset to user_count (via Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)), and Group.findMembers will request offset=user_count, yielding an empty members page (offset 100, limit 50). This is a real behavioral defect visible from the diff.
